text:
Maya (Sales): Quick heads up 10: Brighton Health requested a Day 0 to onboard a 14-day pilot for discharge-summary ingestion + routing. Key asks: PII handling, extraction accuracy, and a cost envelope. Can we meet 11am PT tomorrow?
Diego - Solutions: 11am works. From their brief: primary flows = ingest discharge notes, extract problem list + follow-ups, and surface recommended care-path tags. Want extraction F1 > 0.9 on core entities and recall > 0.85 on follow-up actions.
Priya Patel: Security note: Brighton flagged PHI and wants a BAA, KMS encryption, and audit log exports. They also asked if Redwood can support HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/private.
Liam (Legal): We have a BAA template; I can fast-track once they share legal contact. KMS + HSM support noted 100% for Private or Dedicated with customer-managed keys.
Hannah Eng: Operational items for Day 0: expected concurrency, average token sizes (in/out), preferred region, and whether they want webhook delivery for extracted entities. Also need to know if inbound files will be PDFs or plain text.
Maya (Sales): Brighton said mixed: PDFs + free-text. They asked whether Redwood can do on-the-fly OCR -> extract pipeline or if they must pre-parse.
Diego - Solutions: We can accept pre-parsed text or run OCR in their pipeline. For pilot recommend they pre-parse to avoid OCR variance. We'll include a small OCR example in the runbook if they need it.
Priya Patel: Compliance question: will any data leave their VPC? Brighton prefers no, but for pilot they may allow dedicated-hosted with tenant isolation. Flag: if they require zero egress, we need Private deployment and on-prem or VPC peering.
Liam (Legal): If they insist on zero egress, legal and infra need time for Private deployment contracting. Please capture this in Day 0 escalation items.
Hannah Eng: Performance targets suggested: p95 latency for 10-turn extraction < 900ms, batch ingestion throughput >= 50 docs/min for pilot ingest peak. Also propose fallback model with reduced entity set if capacity hit.
Diego - Solutions: Eval plan: ask Brighton for 200 annotated gold records + 25 adversarial examples (ambiguous notes, redacted fields). We'll run entity-level F1, action recall, and a manual safety review of 50 random outputs.
Maya (Sales): Pricing asks: can Redwood provide a capped trial credit and a committed rate estimate for 200k tokens/day? Brighton wants to compare Hosted vs Dedicated TCO.
Hannah Eng: Cost assumptions we'll use for calc: avg response 400 tokens, ingestion pre-processing ~100 tokens. For 200k tokens/day that maps to ~333 requests/day. I'll prepare a hosted vs dedicated rundown with committed GPU uplift.
Diego - Solutions: I'll prepare seed prompt set and a short evaluator harness. Example prompt we'll use in Day 0 demo:
```
Input (note): "Patient discharged after MI, on aspirin and statin. Follow-up in 7 days. COPD noted in history."
Task: return {"problems":[], "follow_up":[], "care_path_tags":[]} with expected fields and confidence scores.
```
Infra Bot: Action: provision ephemeral trial key, default rate-limit 75rps, expiry in 15 days. Set pilot whitelist: brighton.health domain.
Maya (Sales): Owners for Day 0: Diego (prompts & evals), Hannah (infra sizing & runbook), Priya (security answers & compliance), Liam (legal contact & BAA).
Priya Patel: I'll compile a short security factsheet: KMS/HSM options, data retention controls, audit log export samples, and available SOC2/ISO attestations. Will post within 24h.
Liam (Legal): Will draft BAA + indicate timeline for Private deployment contract addendum. Need Brighton legal contact.
Diego - Solutions: I'll ask Brighton for 200 gold examples and 25 adversarial cases pre-Day 0. If they can't provide full set, bring a 50-example minimum and we'll augment.
Hannah Eng: We'll include a canary fallback: if Dedicated latency > threshold, route to quantized 7B model and tag outputs with "reduced-fidelity". Add this to runbook and test during pilot.
Maya (Sales): Next steps: 1) Confirm 11am PT invite (Maya) 2) Brighton to send stakeholder list + legal contact + sample golds (Brighton) 3) Diego to upload seed prompts + harness (Diego) 4) Hannah to prepare cost scenarios + runbook snippet (Hannah) 5) Priya & Liam to prepare security + legal artifacts (Priya, Liam). Reply here when done.
Brighton Rep (via Maya): Confirmed. Exec sponsor = Dr. Claire M., infra lead = Omar K. Sending sample files now.
Maya (Sales): Thanks all 10 See you at 11am PT. If anything urgent, DM me.
